## 2026-08-07 — Defect-4 stage-0 verdict: the incumbent's advantage is real, larger than remembered, and extends to zero-shot skill {#sec-nb-incumbent-stage0-verdict}

All three gates read out
([artifact](../results/incumbent_stage0_gates_2026-08-07.json),
[reduction](../results/mixedres_training_2026-07-31/sweep/round3_reduction.json)).
**D1**: GeoTransolver at its standard 9.5M config beats the homogeneous
flagship (784k) by **2.63x in-family** on the identical normalized
instrument (0.0530-0.0534 vs 0.1344-0.1447 at 10k) -- the registered
> 1.25x branch: stage 1 is a matched-parameter rung before any
mechanism claim. **D2, the uncomfortable one**: GT is not merely
bounded zero-shot on both SHIFT families -- it is *skilled* (means
0.54-0.64, max 0.68, three seeds, both families), while every
MeshTransformer arm in the program sits at mean-predictor level
(0.78-1.37). The compensating-asset argument for MT (boundedness as
differential) is now empirically dead: the incumbent has boundedness
AND skill. What MT retains: 12x fewer parameters, exact structural
contracts (equivariance, declared degree, zero preservation), and the
measure/quadrature pathway. **D3**: GT's resolution curve is flat
(1.00) with no quadrature machinery at all. **Instrument correction
recorded**: the pdmsh redimensionalized rel-L2 used in earlier sweep
gates understates resolution sensitivity (truth-norm inflation) -- on
the normalized instrument, fixed-trained MT arms show 40k/10k of
1.18x (zpn, defect-1 control re-extracted from HSG) to 1.44-1.66x
(homogeneous), while mixedres-trained arms are genuinely flat. The
defect-1 collapse-cure claim survives (the historical failure was
signal collapse, not a 1.2-1.7x drift), but "mixed-resolution
sampling is unnecessary for resolution transfer" was
instrument-dependent and is hereby weakened: sampling diversity does
flatten the normalized curve. Both instruments stay archived side by
side. Next, per the registered decision rule: the matched-parameter
MeshTransformer rung under the current convention.

## 2026-08-07 — Defect-4 stage-1 preregistration: the matched-parameter rung {#sec-nb-incumbent-stage1-prereg}

Registered before launch
([artifact](../results/incumbent_efficiency_stage1_preregistration_2026-08-07.json),
sha256 d76b6671fc8747ad), per the stage-0 decision rule. Three seeds of
the x2L8 capacity rung (recovered from git, ~9.6M parameters, single
delta: `field_mode=homogeneous`) under the identical protocol and
paired instrument. E1 decides the road: gap to GT <= 1.25x means scale

(predicted yes, p ~ 0.75). Launched on AGA (12-link chains, 3 lanes;
the heavier rung needs roughly 2-3x flagship wall time).

## 2026-08-07 — Two preregistrations for the unattended window: reverse transfer; capacity curve {#sec-nb-reverse-prereg}

Registered before launch, both running through a ~36 h unattended
window on AGA. **Reverse-transfer probe**
([artifact](../results/reverse_transfer_stage0_preregistration_2026-08-07.json),
sha256 bfbe38c922a3715b): train on SHIFT estate (test split sealed),
measure in-family estate plus zero-shot DrivAerML and fastback, for
both GeoTransolver and the homogeneous flagship at 3 seeds each. R1
asks whether the incumbent's zero-shot skill is direction-symmetric
(p ~ 0.55); R2 whether MT stays at mean-predictor level in reverse
(p ~ 0.75); R3 whether the 2.63x in-family gap replicates on a second
family (band 2.0-3.5x declared, p ~ 0.65); R4 MT boundedness in
reverse (p ~ 0.8). Falsifiers cut both ways: R1 failing weakens the

## 2026-08-08 — Defect-4 stage-1 verdict: scale closes most of the gap and breaks the boundedness guarantee {#sec-nb-incumbent-stage1-verdict}

All gates read out
([artifact](../results/incumbent_stage1_gates_2026-08-08.json),
[reduction](../results/mixedres_training_2026-07-31/sweep/rung_reduction.json)).
**E1**: at matched parameters (9.6M vs 9.5M) the incumbent's in-family
advantage falls from 2.63x to **1.42x** (rung seed-mean 0.0757 vs GT
0.0532) -- the registered 1.25-2.0x band: partial, mechanism work
justified. Two sub-findings: scale bought 1.85x over the 784k flagship,
and the per-parameter frontier under the new convention is materially
better than the old-convention extrapolation (2.34x predicted at this
rung). **E2**: capacity buys zero zero-shot skill -- bounded rung seeds
sit at 0.94-1.42, mean-predictor level; prediction held. **E3, the
expensive lesson**: boundedness at scale FAILED 2/3 (predicted 3/3 at
p ~ 0.75). Seed 42 detonates zero-shot on both families (estate mean
41.3, max 175) despite the homogeneous mode. The degree-1 declaration
provably removes the *drive-amplitude* mechanism, but at 9.6M a seed
found a non-drive pathway -- presumably geometry-statistics excursions
through the operator/kernel stream. The stage-1 boundedness claim is
hereby scoped: structural in drive, but empirically conditioned on
scale and seed. Chase-the-anomaly note declared: locating seed 42's
detonation pathway is the natural next mechanism probe, and it may be
the same mechanism as the incumbent's remaining 1.42x (global
information routing). Still pending: the reverse-transfer probe and
capacity-curve points (training through the unattended window).
